This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Jodi]] was a member of this species.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|dark green]] skin, large heads, and set of four pointed tendrils that extended down and out from the tops of said heads.<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Andor Date">{{Andor|One Year Later}} dates the first arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' 2]] to [[4 BBY]].</ref> a member of this species, [[Jodi]], was in attendance at the wedding ceremony of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on [[Chandrila]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> During the following year, at least one member of this species could be seen both within the [[Imperial Senate Building]], as well as at a gathering hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> Approximately a year later, a member of this species was present among the [[Imperial Senate]], visibly affected by [[Mon Mothma]]'s speech given shortly after the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JodiConcept-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
The species made their debut in the [[One Year Later|first episode]] of the [[2025]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> [[Robert Skene]] made a five-part fiberglass mold of this species, sculpted by [[Justin Pitkethly]] as part of work done for [[Neal Scanlan]]'s creature shop, with [[Kenny Wilson]] as Moldshop HOD.<ref name="robskene-Instagram">{{Instagram|username=robskenefx|url=p/DN_hyidEeMZ|name=[[Robert Skene]]|date=2025-08-31|quote=I made a 5 part fiberglass mold of this character, sculpted by @justinpitkethly. They show up multiple times over the season, at the wedding, Sculden's party and in the senate building, always in crowds in the background though. All work done for Neal Scanlan's creature shop, with Kenny Wilson as Moldshop HOD.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/5EOZR}}</ref>
